method: Three new fullbody-constrained Kimodo forward ukemi predictions from creator-owned performance landmarks; two earlier complete backward rolls reused. Four new root2d 6 m/s sprint predictions. Authored lateral brace and controller paths.

variety.selection: state-entry shuffle bag; no immediate repeat with alternatives; hold seed during action/locomotion state; same seed for compared bodies
variety.rejected: Current-version Game Kit Reject reviews excluded
variety.preferred: Variety off uses eligible preferred takes, falling back to first eligible; manual-only takes require explicit library preview
variety.recording: variant-choice and action-start events preserve selected IDs and seeds; live bone/controller layers are baked in Save take; static source exports omit runtime layers

ukemi.contacts: 12–70cm grounded solid, >=0.65m/s, standing locomotion; forward/back from velocity versus facing; clear rollout required; jump/crouch/carry excluded
ukemi.target_cleanup: Per-body, full-skin vertical clearance envelope sampled at30Hz; raw source preserved; this is not learned support or physical balance

modifier.focus: Only game canvas captures mapped Ctrl chords; dialogs/forms and other browser shortcuts pass
modifier.side_reaction: Grounded lateral collision with solid >=12cm, including taller walls; mirrored knee + open support hand, authored1.55sec pose and20cm recoil on approach side

sprint.reason: Creator reports822 glides; new seeds require visual comparison, no claim that generation alone fixes foot slip

scope: Motion/contact candidates for review; automated finite/contact checks do not certify visual naturalness, martial-arts technique or full-mesh collision physics.
